title: TrustBound: Payment-Epoch Completeness Reproducibility Artifact
description: Selected reproducibility artifact accompanying TrustBound: A Mechanized Note on Payment-Epoch Completeness. Contains the Lean admission and provider-contract models and checkers, eight premise-removal mutations, a finite evidence-rule diagnostic and nine tests, source-isolated reproduction runner, reference results and redacted execution evidence, and the separate finite flight-hotel diagnostic from Appendix B. The core checks 14 exported results and reproduces 2,048 records. It establishes conditional model results under a trusted-service contract, not completeness of a real processor deployment or a new general closure principle. Existing tools are required; no credentials, provider calls, SDK or Docker are needed. Author-owned software and accompanying documentation: MIT. Manuscript distribution terms are separate.
